In brief

Dalkey, the prosperous residential suburb in which Stephen teaches at Mr. Deasy's school, about eight miles southeast of central Dublin, was served by a tramline.

At more length

In the photograph at the right, a tram bound for Dalkey passes by another one returning from Terenure. The scene is Grafton Street, Dublin's most elegant shopping promenade.

John Hunt 2013
